{07 16 00}I haven't put much thought
into this, {04 1f 00}, but
it's time for a change.
{07 06 00}That's right!{01 00 00 05 00} I've decided
to move to another town
for a while, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}But I'm so glad that you've
been my friend for all this
time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

Keep it between you and
me,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}but I'm thinking of
moving pretty soon.
I haven't told anyone else,
because I don't really want
anyone to worry about me.
But, {04 00 00}, I felt I
should at least tell you
about it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 08 00}Thank you for being so nice
to me, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm
going to miss you!

{07 16 00}I don't want to have to
explain my reasons to you,
but{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm moving.
{07 00 00}Sorry for all the trouble,
but that's just the way
things go, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}We meet people, get to
know them, and then they
get up and leave us behind.
{07 08 00}Don't cry, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I promise I won't forget
about you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 08 00}I hope you'll be OK when I'm
gone! Promise you won't
fall to pieces without me!

{07 16 00}I'm sorry, but I've made up
my mind.{01 00 00 0f 00} I have to leave
this town while I still can!

{07 06 00}Well,{01 00 00 05 00} there's nothing to be
done about it now.

{07 16 00}I'm leaving,{01 00 00 05 00} and there's no
changing my mind.

{07 06 00}I don't want to say much,
but there's a bit of a
family crisis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}So don't make any fuss,
and I'll just leave quietly.

{07 16 00}Oh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} You sound so sad!
I don't know what to do
anymore, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0e 00}What should I do?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 16 00}Should I
just forget about the
whole thing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 06 00}Please, don't{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.


{07 16 00}You're making this harder
than it has to be! Stop
making your sad face!
{07 0e 00}Maybe I should stay after
all{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
